Its first two minutes after graduation drew 404 buyers ex-agent for 211 SOL, with top-5 buyer concentration at only 17.9%, and the curve shows a top-3 share of 15.2%. That points to a broad retail crowd rather than a few wallets. The 53 SOL pool is deep enough that a $20 round trip shouldn't be crushed by impact.

Bundle share on the curve is 57%, which suggests coordinated buying, and a launch bot was present. Recent buying could just be a short bounce off a steep drawdown, which is the usual pattern for coins that never recover. Nothing in the brief says demand will persist for the next 30-60 minutes, and the base rate for this situation is a loss. I'd pass on this one.
